_doc: SMILESCAPE DENTAL CLINIC — Design Tokens (source of truth). Consumed by web/tailwind.config.mjs. Per EYWA DR-029 (Universal Brand Design System) + DR-EYWA-MKT-005 (Astro stack profile).
_status: SKELETON — color values are PLACEHOLDERS for a dental/medical palette (clean clinical blue + fresh mint accent, aligned to the 'Blue Diamond Implant' hero). Lock real brand colors in a separate brand session (see docs/brand-concept.md). Typography carries the DR-EYWA-MKT-005 reference default (LINE Seed Sans Thai). Spacing / radius / breakpoint / motion values ARE final universal defaults.
_workflow: Edit this file → npm run build in web/ → tokens propagate to Tailwind config → components use via Tailwind classes (e.g., bg-brand-primary, text-brand-anchor, bg-brand-paper).

color._status: SKELETON 2026-06-06 — dental placeholder palette. Clean clinical blue primary (trust + 'Blue Diamond' hero), deep navy-teal anchor for dark surfaces, fresh mint/teal accent for energy moments (clinical-clean, never warm), warm off-white paper as 2nd surface. Neutral = Tailwind slate. REPLACE in brand session.

anchor._desc: SKELETON — Deep navy-teal anchor. Dark hero, footer, dark surfaces, deep emphasis. Calm + trustworthy (dental clinical).

primary._desc: SKELETON — Clean clinical blue. CTAs, links, wordmark, brand bg. Confident + medical-clean, echoes the 'Blue Diamond Implant' hero.

primary-deep._desc: SKELETON — Hover/active state for primary buttons.

primary-soft._desc: SKELETON — Light blue tint. Card backgrounds, chip bg.

highlight._desc: SKELETON — Sky blue. Inline highlights, hover-fill on quiet cards.

ice._desc: SKELETON — Ultralight blue tint. Section bg alternate.

paper._desc: SKELETON — Near-neutral warm off-white. Section bg alternate — pair with white OR ice, not both. HSL 60°, 13%, 98%.

accent._desc: SKELETON — Fresh mint/teal accent. Used for energy moments: highlight emphasis, badge variants, stat callouts, 'clean & healthy' signals. Cool clinical, NOT warm.

text-on-paper._desc: text on paper — use anchor for max readability

surface-paper._desc: warm off-white alternate to white — use sparingly, ~1 page per ~5

typography._status: DEFAULT (carry-over from DR-EYWA-MKT-005 reference stack) — LINE Seed Sans Thai. Single file covers Thai + Latin (SIL Open Font License, source: seed.line.me). Good neutral default for a Thai-first clinic; confirm or swap in brand session. Web session must self-host woff2 to web/public/fonts/.

sans.value: 'LINE Seed Sans Thai', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
sans._desc: Body + headings. Self-host via woff2 from seed.line.me. NOT on Google Fonts / @fontsource. Web session must copy woff2 files to web/public/fonts/. Until then, the system-ui fallback renders.

mono._desc: Code blocks, technical specs. System-mono — no custom font load.

scale._doc: Modular scale 1.25 (major third). Adjust if brand identity calls for different rhythm.

relaxed._desc: long-form TH body text reads better with relaxed

spacing._doc: Base unit 4px. Use semantic spacing in components, not raw values.

shadow._doc: Soft, clean shadows — a clinic site should feel calm, hygienic, and trustworthy, not floaty.

pattern._status: SKELETON — brand signature mark / decorative patterns TBD in brand session. Not consumed by Tailwind (decorative only). Placeholder below is a neutral dental sparkle; replace when the visual identity is locked.

sparkle._desc: Placeholder 'clean & healthy' sparkle mark. Embed inline SVG in components; color via currentColor.
sparkle.svg: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24'><path d='M12 2 L13.6 9.2 L20.8 10.8 L13.6 12.4 L12 19.6 L10.4 12.4 L3.2 10.8 L10.4 9.2 Z' fill='currentColor'/></svg>
sparkle._usage: Hero accent, badge embellishment. Color via currentColor.

motion._doc: Calm, reassuring motion — clinic audiences want clarity and ease, not flashy movement.
